question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**great**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given sentence is '**great**'.
 
• It means 'large in amount, degree, size, etc.; a lot of'. (मात्रा, आकार आदि में बड़ा; बहुत अधिक)
 
 
• *Example: The party was a **great** success.*
 
 
 
• Here, no comparison is being **made** neither there is any **superlative degree situation**. This is a** general statement.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *New cycle routes have been built in and around the centre of Birmingham and speed limits have been reduced on selected roads.
